description: This file provides utility functions for object detection using YOLOv3, including image preprocessing, bounding box drawing, IoU computation, prediction transformation, and Non-Maximum Suppression. It is a key component in the object detection pipeline.

methods.name: np.ndarray draw_bbox_and_label(x : torch.Tensor, label : str, img : np.ndarray)
methods.description: Draws a bounding box and label on an image for visualization.

methods.name: np.ndarray letterbox_image( image : np.ndarray, inp_dim : Tuple[int, int])
methods.description: Resizes an image maintaining aspect ratio and fills extra space with a gray canvas.

methods.name: torch.Tensor prepare_image( image : np.ndarray, inp_dim : Tuple[int, int])
methods.description: Prepares an image tensor suitable as input to the YOLOv3 model.

methods.name: bbox_iou(bbox1 : torch.Tensor, bbox2 : torch.Tensor, device="cpu")
methods.description: Calculates the Intersection over Union (IoU) between bounding boxes.

methods.name: torch.Tensor transform_prediction( pred : torch.Tensor, inp_dim : int, anchors : Union[List[int], Tuple[int, ...], torch.Tensor], num_classes : int, device : str = "cpu" )
methods.description: Transforms raw model predictions into usable bounding box coordinates.

methods.name: Union[torch.Tensor,int] get_predictions( pred : torch.Tensor, num_classes : int, objectness_confidence : float = 0.5, nms_confidence_level : float = 0.4, device : str = "cpu")
methods.description: Filters the model predictions by confidence and applies NMS, returning filtered bounding boxes.
